definitions.full: H2462. Chelbah חֶלְבָּה proper name, of a location town assigned to Asher Judg 1:31 , site unknown, ᵐ5 Ξεβδα , ᵐ5 L Ελβα ; (compare Assyrian Ma—alliba Schr Dl, but see אַחְלָב below)
